name: B10-0458/2026 (PPE) – The cases of Ali Karimli, Anar Mammadli and other political prisoners in Azerbaijan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the cases of Ali Karimli, Anar Mammadli and other political prisoners in Azerbaijan
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns Azerbaijan for holding people it calls political prisoners, including opposition leader Ali Karimli and election monitor Anar Mammadli, and says they should be freed and all charges dropped. It asks European Union officials and member states to raise these cases with Azerbaijan, to watch trials and visit prisons, and to keep any future partnership deal dependent on human rights improvements.

- Nothing changes yet; the Parliament only asks for Karimli, Mammadli and other prisoners to be released.
- It affects Azerbaijan's government, its prisoners, and European Union officials asked to act.
- Next: European Union officials and member states are asked to raise the cases and observe trials.
